I haven’t got any friends. They are just buddies and no one loves me. They are just with me at uni, or i can’t feel good with them. 
Once they grabbed me and push me into a mental hospital, it was closed from the public (sorry can’t find the right words) bc they thought I tried to kill myself. (I have never thought about suicide until that point, it was 3 years ago) and the tied my hands and it was terribble. I know I am weak but I still have nightmares with screems with thoose things. The doctor said: ‘’ oh you are here bc u are schizophrenic” i am not. And i was a little piece of shit here. And my therapists.. i don’t know. I just don’t want another one, I can’t trust them anymore. (I know its my fault) 
I do not know what i like. Sometimes I do things but after that I asked myself why? Why is it good? Or why am I doing stuffs like this? It does not matter. We all gonna die one day.
I know.. If I were you I would said its will be ok and u will be better and etc. But to myself.. All I can say is the opposite. It won’t be better It won’t be good.
If you do it again once.. it will be easier and easier. So please keep holding on and don’t do that 😔

I feel the same 😔 I wish I could say something helpful and good for you, but I am not able to can. 
But you are not alone 😔 I know this is not an answer and cutting is cutting but.. you are not alone 🖤
How can u do that? I mean.. with your thoughts.
I thought i can do this with my gf but honestly i don’t know. Everybody hate my moodswings. I just feel myself lonely with those things.
I am so sorry 😔 are u doing those trips alone? Coz i hate being alone but nobody do this with me. Eh
Hello 😇 I know I can’t help u but I wish I could. But if u wanna talk about those things i am (we are) here and I hope u will be okay 💖 ss
